slices.focus: Tasha and Caleb begin clinic outreach with referral handout, follow-up timeline, and eligibility page
slices.summary: Tasha steps into a new phase: leading outreach to palliative and clinic partners alongside Caleb. They visit staff meetings with a simple referral handout, a sample 13-month follow-up timeline after a death, and a one-page group eligibility explanation. The timeline gets the strongest reaction — clinic staff say they had never seen the first year laid out month by month. The agent helps Tasha plan shared language with Caleb (two or three exact phrases about access, wait times, and fit), light sign-off on the materials from one senior person, and lean tracking of clinic-source referrals to measure whether the outreach is improving the pipeline. Tasha recognizes this as a shift from running a service to designing how other teams connect to it.
